name: 面向财务资产会计的 SAP Fiori 分析应用 (2QY)
name_en: SAP Fiori Analytical Apps for Asset Accounting in Finance (2QY)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item provides overview pages for the Asset Accounting functionality, with a focus on assisting the Asset Accountant with high-level information about revenue, expense, journal entries, asset accounts balance, and more.

Key Process Flow

  • See analytical and transactional display of the revenue, expense, journal entries, asset account balances, and so on
  • Filter the KPIs per the different business attributes, such as company code, financial statement version, key date, display currency, and so on
  • Navigate from the KPI insights to the corresponding smart apps for detailed analysis
  • Share high-level KPI and process information with persons responsible for process execution in Asset Accounting department

Business Benefits

  • Provide a dashboard of information for the Asset Accountant to smoothly perform their daily activities
  • Provide high-level insights for the Asset Accountant to understand the key numbers and drill down to action on a wide variety of information
  • Provide insights into the different aspects of the Asset Accounting functionality to meet the requirements
  • Get an overview into the different functionality such as the revenue, expense, journal entries, asset accounts balance, and so on
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目提供资产会计功能的概览页面，重点为资产会计提供有关收入、费用、日记账分录、资产科目余额等的高级信息。

关键流程流

  • 查看收入、费用、日记账分录、资产科目余额等的分析和交易显示
  • 根据不同的业务属性（例如公司代码、财务报表版本、关键日期、显示货币等）过滤 KPI
  • 从 KPI 洞察导航到相应的智能应用以进行详细分析
  • 与资产会计部门中负责流程执行的人员共享高级 KPI 和流程信息

业务优势

  • 为资产会计提供信息仪表盘，以便顺利执行日常活动
  • 为资产会计提供高级分析，以了解关键数字并根据各种信息下钻到操作
  • 提供对资产会计功能的不同方面的分析，以满足要求
  • 了解不同的功能，例如收入、费用、日记账分录、资产科目余额等
